children.name: Gelsemium elegans  Benth.
children.description: Gelsemium elegans, commonly known as heartbreak grass, is a poisonous plant of the family Gelsemiaceae found in China and other Asian countries.

children.name: Gelsemium rankinii Small
children.description: Gelsemium rankinii, the Rankin's trumpetflower or swamp jessamine, is a twining vine in the family Gelsemiaceae, native to the southeastern United States from Louisiana to the Carolinas.

children.name: Gelsemium sempervirens  J.St.-Hil.
children.description: Gelsemium sempervirens is a twining vine in the family Gelsemiaceae, native to subtropical and tropical America: Honduras, Guatemala, Belize, Mexico (Chiapas, Oaxaca, Veracruz, Puebla, Hidalgo), and southeastern and south-central United States (from Texas to Virginia).

children.name: Mostuea adamii Sillans
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Trop. Africa. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Mostuea batesii Baker
children.description: The native range of this species is WC. Trop. Africa. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Mostuea brunonis Didr.
children.description: Shrub, in open forest, forest galleries, and thicket. C. N.: kapoloto (kb). Uses: artefacts medicinal. F. Monteiro 752 (LUAI, LISC)

children.name: Mostuea hirsuta  Baill.
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Trop. Africa to South Sudan and Angola. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Mostuea hymenocardioides Hutch. & Dalziel
children.description: The native range of this species is Guinea to Sierra Leone. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Mostuea microphylla Gilg
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Somalia to Mozambique and C. DR Congo. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Mostuea muricata Sobral & Lucia Rossi
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Mato Grosso, São Paulo). It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Mostuea neurocarpa Gilg
children.description: The native range of this species is WC. Trop. Africa. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Mostuea rubrinervis Engl.
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Kenya to E. Tanzania. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Mostuea surinamensis Benth.
children.description: The native range of this species is Suriname to N. Brazil. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Pteleocarpa lamponga  Bakh. ex K.Heyne
children.description: The native range of this species is Pen. Thailand to W. Malesia. It is a tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
